## 5. Formatting Collisions
Math equations injected in code blocks: `const x = 5; $$ E=mc^2 $$`
Code injected in math equations: $$ E = mc^2 \text{`const y = 10;`} $$
HTML inside math: $$ \frac{1}{2} <b>bold</b> $$
